name: [UPDATE 3] Subaru Stairs Experience
desc:
An unopened copy of the Bloodborne PC port lies at the top of the tower. Will you be able to reach it?

Keep climbing the stairs to reach greater amounts of madness, and once you are mad enough you will be able to rebirth and get even stronger!

Conquer for the highscore between others players to see who gets the closest to the Bloodborne PC port! Buy Items and hatch Eggs to get stronger and faster to climb the tower even faster!
